final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, o.ordertune AS order_type, AVG(f.rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG((f.rebrate - f.feerate) / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_rate_difference FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.ordertune), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) AS overall_avg_rebate FROM step1) SELECT s1.orderslink, s1.order_type, s1.avg_rebate, s1.avg_rate_difference, s1.avg_rebate - s2.overall_avg_rebate AS rebate_difference FROM step1 AS s1 CROSS JOIN step2 AS s2 WHERE s1.avg_rebate > s2.overall_avg_rebate ORDER BY rebate_difference DESC LIMIT 10
